text: 2026 BMW M4 Competition — Coupe, RWD, Gas. Asking price: $89,900. Mileage: 28 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Brooklyn Grey Metallic. Condition: New. VIN: WBS43AY09SCT12345. Stock #: M4D-2026-017. MSRP: $92,595. Exterior color: Brooklyn Grey Metallic. Interior: Black Merino Leather. Seats 4 across 2 doors. Engine: 3.0L M TwinPower Turbo inline-6 making 503 hp and 479 lb-ft @ 2,750-5,500 rpm. Transmission: 8-speed M Steptronic automatic. 0-60 mph in 3.8 seconds; top speed 155 mph. Fuel: Premium unleaded; 16 city / 23 highway / 19 combined mpg; 15.6-gallon tank. Warranty: 4-year / 50,000-mile new-vehicle limited warranty, 3-year / 36,000-mile complimentary scheduled maintenance, and 12-year unlimited-mile rust perforation coverage. Packages: Carbon Fiber Roof, M Carbon Bucket Seats, Executive Package, M Driver's Package, Driving Assistance Professional Package. Options: Harman Kardon Surround Sound, Heated steering wheel, Head-up display, Adaptive M suspension, M Sport differential, Carbon fiber interior trim, Laserlight headlights, Wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, Parking Assistant Plus with surround-view cameras. Features: M TwinPower Turbo 3.0L inline-6 (503 hp), 8-speed M Steptronic transmission, Rear-wheel drive with M Sport differential, Adaptive M suspension, M Carbon bucket seats, Carbon-fiber roof, Carbon-fiber interior and exterior trim, Black Merino leather interior, Head-up display, Harman Kardon surround sound, Laserlight headlights, Driving Assistance Professional, Parking Assistant Plus with surround-view cameras, Wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto. This 2026 BMW M4 Competition is a rear-wheel-drive performance coupe powered by a 3.0-liter M TwinPower Turbo inline-six producing 503 horsepower and 479 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed M Steptronic automatic. It sprints from 0 to 60 mph in 3.8 seconds and is electronically limited to 155 mph (180 mph with the M Driver's Package). Finished in Brooklyn Grey Metallic over a Black Merino leather interior, it features M Carbon bucket seats, a carbon-fiber roof, carbon-fiber interior and exterior accents, the Executive Package, Driving Assistance Professional, Harman Kardon surround sound, a head-up display, and Laserlight headlights. As a new demonstrator unit it shows just 28 delivery miles and is backed by BMW's 4-year/50,000-mile new-vehicle warranty with complimentary scheduled maintenance. EPA-estimated fuel economy is 16 city / 23 highway / 19 combined mpg.

text: 2022 Toyota Highlander XLE — SUV, AWD, Gas. Asking price: $38,990. Mileage: 31,450 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Blueprint. Features: Three-row seating for 8, All-wheel drive, Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, Blind-spot monitoring, Power liftgate, Tri-zone climate control. A roomy three-row family SUV with all-wheel drive and seating for up to eight, the 2022 Toyota Highlander XLE is the practical, reliable choice for road trips, car pools, and growing families. Comfortable second-row captain's-style space, a big cargo area behind the third row, and Toyota's reputation for low cost of ownership make it an easy daily driver. Strong safety scores, blind-spot monitoring, and a smooth 295-hp V6 returning around 24 mpg combined.

2021 Honda Pilot EX-L — SUV, AWD, Gas. Asking price: $34,500. Mileage: 42,980 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Modern Steel Metallic. Features: Seats 8 in three rows, All-wheel drive, Leather interior, Heated front seats, Honda Sensing safety suite, Rear entertainment ready. The 2021 Honda Pilot EX-L is a spacious eight-seat family SUV built for hauling kids, gear, and everything in between. Three rows of comfortable seating, a flexible cargo hold, and standard Honda Sensing driver-assist make it a dependable family hauler for school runs and weekend trips. Smooth V6 power, available all-wheel drive for bad weather, and a leather cabin with heated seats.

2021 Subaru Outback Premium — Wagon, AWD, Gas. Asking price: $27,900. Mileage: 38,700 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Autumn Green Metallic. Features: Standard symmetrical AWD, 8.7 inches of ground clearance, X-MODE for trails, EyeSight driver assist, Roof rails, Heated seats. Part rugged SUV, part efficient wagon, the 2021 Subaru Outback Premium is the go-anywhere family and adventure vehicle. Standard all-wheel drive, 8.7 inches of ground clearance, and X-MODE make it confident in snow, rain, and light off-road trails, while the comfortable five-seat cabin and big cargo area handle camping gear and dog crates. Great visibility, top safety ratings, and roughly 29 mpg combined.

2022 Kia Telluride S — SUV, AWD, Gas. Asking price: $39,995. Mileage: 27,300 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Ebony Black. Features: Three-row seating for 8, All-wheel drive, Wireless phone charger, Roomy cargo space, Highway Driving Assist, Dual sunroof. An award-winning three-row family SUV, the 2022 Kia Telluride S blends near-luxury comfort with serious practicality and value. Eight-passenger seating, a huge cargo area, and an upscale cabin make it ideal for big families and long trips, while available all-wheel drive adds bad-weather confidence. Excellent safety, a strong V6, and standout features for the price.

2020 Honda Odyssey EX-L — Minivan, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $29,900. Mileage: 51,200 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Pacific Pewter Metallic. Features: Seats 8, Power sliding doors, Magic Slide second-row seats, Rear-seat reminder, CabinWatch camera, Tri-zone climate. The ultimate family hauler, the 2020 Honda Odyssey EX-L minivan seats eight with sliding doors that make loading kids and car seats effortless. Magic Slide seats reconfigure for cargo or passengers, rear entertainment keeps kids happy, and CabinWatch lets you keep an eye on the back rows. Comfortable, safe, and built for family road trips and daily school runs.

2021 Toyota Sienna XLE — Minivan, FWD, Hybrid. Asking price: $36,500. Mileage: 33,800 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Celestial Silver Metallic. Features: Hybrid powertrain ~36 mpg, Seats 8, Power sliding doors, Toyota Safety Sense, Wireless charging, Smooth quiet ride. The 2021 Toyota Sienna XLE is a hybrid family minivan that delivers around 36 mpg while seating up to eight. Power sliding doors, a flexible interior, and Toyota Safety Sense make it a fuel-efficient, low-running-cost choice for families who want minivan space without the gas-guzzling. Quiet, comfortable, and ultra-reliable for daily duty and long highway trips.

2020 Toyota Corolla LE — Sedan, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $18,900. Mileage: 39,600 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Classic Silver Metallic. Features: ~32 mpg combined, Apple CarPlay, Toyota Safety Sense, Backup camera, Lane departure alert, Low cost to own. The safe, affordable, cheap-to-own 2020 Toyota Corolla LE is the perfect first car or no-fuss commuter. Excellent fuel economy around 32 mpg combined, bulletproof reliability, standard Toyota Safety Sense, and a comfortable easy-to-drive cabin. Low insurance, low maintenance, and a car that just won't quit — ideal for students, new drivers, and budget-minded buyers.

2021 Honda Civic Sport — Sedan, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $22,400. Mileage: 28,900 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Rallye Red. Features: ~34 mpg combined, Sporty handling, Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, Honda Sensing, Sunroof, Alloy wheels. Fun to drive yet efficient, the 2021 Honda Civic Sport is a compact sedan that nails the balance of sporty handling, great fuel economy near 34 mpg, and everyday practicality. A roomy interior, modern tech, and Honda's reliability make it a fantastic commuter or first car for someone who still wants a little driving enjoyment. Sharp looks and a strong resale reputation.

2021 Mazda Mazda3 Select — Sedan, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $21,900. Mileage: 31,100 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Soul Red Crystal. Features: Premium-feeling cabin, ~31 mpg combined, Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, Blind-spot monitoring, Leatherette seats, Engaging handling. The 2021 Mazda3 Select punches above its price with a near-luxury interior and genuinely engaging handling. A great-looking compact sedan that's efficient around 31 mpg, well-equipped, and more upscale-feeling than typical economy cars — a smart pick for a stylish commuter or a refined first car that doesn't feel cheap.

2022 Honda Accord Sport — Sedan, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $27,600. Mileage: 24,100 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Still Night Pearl. Features: Roomy midsize sedan, ~30 mpg combined, Leather seats, Apple CarPlay, Sunroof, Wireless charging. The 2022 Honda Accord Sport is a roomy, sharp-looking midsize sedan that drives younger than it is. Spacious for families and commuters alike, efficient around 30 mpg, and loaded with leather, a sunroof, and wireless charging. A comfortable, reliable do-everything sedan with a big trunk and a strong turbo engine.

2021 Toyota Camry SE — Sedan, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $25,900. Mileage: 35,400 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Predawn Gray Mica. Features: Reliable midsize sedan, ~32 mpg combined, Toyota Safety Sense, Sport-tuned suspension, Apple CarPlay, Spacious trunk. The 2021 Toyota Camry SE is the benchmark reliable midsize sedan — comfortable, efficient near 32 mpg, and famously dependable. A spacious cabin and trunk make it great for families and commuters, while the SE's sport-tuned suspension adds a bit of fun. Low ownership costs and rock-solid resale value.

2020 Ford F-150 XLT — Truck, 4WD, Gas. Asking price: $36,900. Mileage: 48,700 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Oxford White. Features: 3.5L EcoBoost V6, Up to ~13,000 lb towing, 4x4, SuperCrew cab, Trailer tow package, Bed liner. The 2020 Ford F-150 XLT SuperCrew is a full-size work-and-tow truck with serious capability. The 3.5L EcoBoost V6 delivers strong towing up to around 13,000 lbs, 4x4 handles job sites and bad weather, and the roomy crew cab seats the whole crew. Perfect for contractors, towing boats or trailers, and anyone who needs a hard-working pickup.

2021 Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Road — Truck, 4WD, Gas. Asking price: $37,500. Mileage: 36,200 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Army Green. Features: TRD Off-Road suspension, Crawl Control & locking rear diff, 4x4, Skid plates, Double cab, Legendary resale. The 2021 Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Road is a midsize trail-ready pickup built for adventure. Locking rear differential, Crawl Control, skid plates, and a beefed-up suspension make it genuinely capable off-road, while Toyota reliability and famous resale value keep it sensible. A great choice for overlanding, weekend trails, and daily duty alike.

2020 Jeep Wrangler Sport S — SUV, 4WD, Gas. Asking price: $31,900. Mileage: 41,800 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Firecracker Red. Features: Removable top & doors, Solid-axle 4x4, Trail-rated, Skid plates, Apple CarPlay, Off-road tires. The 2020 Jeep Wrangler Sport S is the iconic open-air off-roader — removable doors and top, trail-rated 4x4, and serious capability on rocks, sand, and mud. Rugged, fun, and endlessly customizable, it's the obvious pick for off-road enthusiasts and anyone who wants a vehicle with personality and go-anywhere ability.

2020 Porsche 718 Cayman S — Coupe, RWD, Gas. Asking price: $62,400. Mileage: 18,600 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: GT Silver Metallic. Features: 350-hp turbo flat-four, PDK dual-clutch, Sport Chrono, Mid-engine balance, Bose surround sound, 20-inch wheels. The 2020 Porsche 718 Cayman S is a perfectly balanced mid-engine sports car — a pure driver's machine. Its 350-hp turbocharged flat-four and lightning PDK transmission deliver thrilling performance, while the mid-engine layout gives it razor-sharp handling. Low miles, Sport Chrono, and Bose audio. A weekend toy and track-day star that's still usable daily.

2019 Ford Mustang GT — Coupe, RWD, Gas. Asking price: $33,900. Mileage: 34,500 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Velocity Blue. Features: 5.0L V8 (460 hp), 6-speed manual, Active exhaust, Brembo brakes, Launch control, Recaro-style seats. The 2019 Ford Mustang GT is a classic American muscle coupe with a roaring 5.0L V8 making 460 horsepower and a proper 6-speed manual. Active exhaust, Brembo brakes, and launch control make it a fast, fun, attainable performance car for someone who wants V8 thrills and a stick shift without supercar money.

2021 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 2LT — Coupe, RWD, Gas. Asking price: $74,900. Mileage: 12,400 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Torch Red. Features: 6.2L mid-engine V8 (495 hp), 0-60 in ~2.9s, 8-speed dual-clutch, Magnetic Ride Control, Removable roof, Bose performance audio. The 2021 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is a mid-engine American supercar bargain. Its 495-hp 6.2L V8 launches it to 60 mph in under 3 seconds, with exotic looks and handling for a fraction of European supercar prices. Low miles, removable roof, and a stunning Torch Red finish — a head-turning fast weekend car that's surprisingly livable.

2022 Tesla Model 3 Long Range — Sedan, AWD, Electric. Asking price: $33,900. Mileage: 26,800 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Pearl White. Features: ~330 mile range, Dual-motor AWD, 0-60 in ~4.2s, Autopilot, 15-inch touchscreen, Supercharger access. The 2022 Tesla Model 3 Long Range is an efficient, quick all-electric sedan with around 330 miles of range and dual-motor all-wheel drive. Zero gas, low running costs, rapid 0-60 near 4.2 seconds, Autopilot, and access to the Supercharger network. A tech-forward EV that's perfect for commuters who want to ditch gas without sacrificing performance or range.

2021 Ford Mustang Mach-E Premium — SUV, AWD, Electric. Asking price: $34,900. Mileage: 29,400 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Rapid Red Metallic. Features: ~270 mile range, Dual-motor AWD, Hands-free BlueCruise ready, Frunk storage, Panoramic glass roof, Fast charging. The 2021 Ford Mustang Mach-E Premium is an all-electric SUV that blends EV efficiency with family practicality. Around 270 miles of range, dual-motor AWD for all-weather grip, a roomy five-seat cabin with a panoramic roof, and a front trunk for extra storage. A gas-free crossover that's quick, spacious, and ideal for an eco-minded family or commuter.

2021 Lexus RX 350 Premium — SUV, AWD, Gas. Asking price: $41,900. Mileage: 30,900 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Nebula Gray Pearl. Features: Quiet luxury cabin, All-wheel drive, Heated & ventilated seats, Lexus Safety System+, Mark Levinson audio ready, Premium leather. The 2021 Lexus RX 350 Premium is a refined luxury SUV known for its whisper-quiet cabin, plush ride, and legendary Lexus reliability. All-wheel drive, heated and ventilated leather seats, and a long list of comfort features make it a sumptuous yet sensible family luxury crossover. Low maintenance, strong resale, and upscale without being flashy.

2021 Audi Q5 Premium Plus — SUV, AWD, Gas. Asking price: $36,900. Mileage: 32,600 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Mythos Black Metallic. Features: Quattro all-wheel drive, Virtual Cockpit, Leather seats, Panoramic sunroof, Bang & Olufsen ready, Turbo efficiency. The 2021 Audi Q5 Premium Plus is a premium compact luxury SUV with standard Quattro all-wheel drive and a high-tech, beautifully built cabin. The digital Virtual Cockpit, leather seats, and panoramic roof deliver an upscale feel, while the efficient turbo and AWD make it a confident all-weather daily. A great blend of luxury, tech, and practicality.

text: 2018 Honda Fit LX — Hatchback, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $13,900. Mileage: 58,200 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Aegean Blue Metallic. Features: ~36 mpg combined, Magic Seats, Apple CarPlay, Backup camera, Huge interior for its size, Very low cost to own. Tiny on the outside, huge on the inside — the 2018 Honda Fit LX is a perfect cheap first car or city commuter. Class-leading interior space thanks to Magic Seats, excellent fuel economy around 36 mpg, and Honda dependability at a budget price. Easy to park, cheap to insure and maintain, and endlessly practical for students and new drivers.

2021 Hyundai Elantra SEL — Sedan, FWD, Gas. Asking price: $19,400. Mileage: 33,500 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Phantom Black. Features: ~37 mpg combined, Bold styling, Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, Hyundai SmartSense safety, Spacious cabin, Long warranty remaining. The 2021 Hyundai Elantra SEL is a budget-friendly compact sedan with standout styling and outstanding fuel economy near 37 mpg. A surprisingly spacious cabin, modern tech, standard safety features, and Hyundai's strong remaining warranty make it a smart, affordable choice for a first car or value commuter.
